aggregation: The display contract is an equal-weight mean of 3 queries. These cells are single placeholder numbers, not that mean.
excluded_family: SLT is not a third curve.

states.On-cold: equivalent input cost U-Q at beta=0

limit_500: explicit buffer; a LIMIT point, connected to the other LIMIT points
full: explicit full mode; not a LIMIT n; not K=510; not joined to LIMIT 500
quality: NDCG@10 at every endpoint, including every LIMIT n and Full. Not Spearman, not nDCG@K.
kh: No (k,h) is printed on the curve. A shared (k,h) for the 3-query aggregate would be fictional. Per-query choices belong in a table that does not exist yet.
y_limit_note: Off and On-cold do not share a cost scale. Both quality rows use the same NDCG@10 window. Limits are fixed in this file so a panel cannot autoscale a small placeholder gap into a large visual gap of its own.
axis: LIMIT n is an ordered categorical list of the contract points. Slot spacing is equal and is not linear in n. Full sits on a broken-off axis.
